llm.summary: This China-focused teacher reporting skill uses scoped student learning records to draft renewal reports and does not show hidden execution, sending, deletion, or exfiltration behavior.

dimensions.detail: Requested platform capabilities and workspace fields are proportionate to report generation and include fallbacks when platform memory/statistics/date capabilities are unavailable.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package consists of Markdown and JSON schema/reference files only; I found no executable scripts, package installation steps, remote payload retrieval, or tool wrapping.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions require a named student before reading records, limit reads to relevant fields, require consent checks for parent-visible content, and forbid sending messages, cross-student scans, fabricated metrics, status changes, or full record deletion.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill can create or delete only its own stage-evidence records after confirmation; it explicitly avoids modifying student cards, course ledgers, parent communication logs, authorization settings, reminders, or deletion workflows.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill reads sensitive longitudinal student learning records and writes limited progressEvidence entries, but this is clearly tied to its stated purpose of producing evidence-based stage and renewal reports.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only for the intended Mainland China Chinese K12 teacher workflow. Before using parent-facing reports, verify that the student consent fields are current, review every generated report yourself, and keep sending or record lifecycle changes in the separate teacher-controlled workflows as the skill requires.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: SkillSpector's language concern is downgraded: the package is Chinese-only, but shared/platform-conventions.md explicitly states the library is designed for Mainland China Chinese K12 use, making the locale choice disclosed and coherent rather than hidden or purpose-mismatched.
[AIG-SARIF] expected: The supplied static scan reported no T01-T09 results, and artifact inspection found no prompt hijacking, memory poisoning, remote execution, embedded code, privilege escalation, persistence, or tool spoofing evidence.
